say:1:1030102201:0.text: Magister, can you feel the chill here?
say:1:1030102201:0.source_cn: 魔法师，你也感到凉意了吧？
say:1:1030102201:0.male: Magister, can you feel the chill here?
say:1:1030102201:0.female: Magister, can you feel the chill here?

say:2:1030102202:0.text: It's been many years. Now, the bitter cold has come back to Ryeham.
say:2:1030102202:0.source_cn: 金穗村多少年没经历的严寒，现在已经来临了。
say:2:1030102202:0.male: It's been many years. Now, the bitter cold has come back to Ryeham.
say:2:1030102202:0.female: It's been many years. Now, the bitter cold has come back to Ryeham.

say:3:1030102203:0.text: Magister Merlin didn't bless our lovely village like last time. And, of course, a gang of greedy bandits arrived.
say:3:1030102203:0.source_cn: 梅林大人并没有像上次一样保佑我们可爱的村子，取而代之，...
say:3:1030102203:0.male: Magister Merlin didn't bless our lovely village like last time. And, of course, a gang of greedy bandits arrived.
say:3:1030102203:0.female: Magister Merlin didn't bless our lovely village like last time. And, of course, a gang of greedy bandits arrived.

say:4:1030102204:0.text: I wish my song could make the bandits go away and bring back our hero.
say:4:1030102204:0.source_cn: 如果我的歌声能驱散强盗，呼唤曾经的英雄就好了。
say:4:1030102204:0.male: I wish my song could make the bandits go away and bring back our hero.
say:4:1030102204:0.female: I wish my song could make the bandits go away and bring back our heroine.
